description: Remove a till from Run → Stations. Takes the station id from get_stations. CONFIRM WITH THE MERCHANT FIRST, naming the station — there is NO undo from here, and it takes a working register out of service: the device that used it has to be set up again in the POS app, and it comes back as a NEW station with a new id. A station reporting IN_USE is REFUSED, exactly as the cabinet greys the button out — the shift has to be closed on the device first. If the merchant insists that till is idle, the flag is stale (it was closed while the device was offline); it clears once the device reconnects, so try again then instead of forcing anything. Past orders, sessions and End of Session reports keep naming this station and are not touched.

stationId.description: Station id from get_stations — not a name
